verses.en: And there went a man of the house of Levi, and took to wife a daughter of Levi.
verses.pt: Foi-se um homem da casa de Levi e casou com uma filha de Levi.
verses.en_web: A man of the house of Levi went and took a daughter of Levi as his wife.
verses.en_bbe: Now a man of the house of Levi took as his wife a daughter of Levi.

verses.en: And the woman conceived, and bare a son: and when she saw him that he was a goodly child, she hid him three months.
verses.pt: A mulher concebeu e deu à luz um filho; e, vendo que ele era formoso, escondeu-o três meses.
verses.en_web: The woman conceived, and bore a son. When she saw that he was a fine child, she hid him three months.
verses.en_bbe: And she became with child and gave birth to a Son; and when she saw that he was a beautiful child, she kept him secretly for three months.

verses.en: And when she could not longer hide him, she took for him an ark of bulrushes, and daubed it with slime and with pitch, and put the child therein; and she laid it in the flags by the river’s brink.
verses.pt: Não podendo, porém, escondê-lo por mais tempo, tomou para ele uma arca de juncos, e a revestiu de betume e pez; e, pondo nela o menino, colocou-a entre os juncos a margem do rio.
verses.en_web: When she could no longer hide him, she took a papyrus basket for him, and coated it with tar and with pitch. She put the child in it, and laid it in the reeds by the river’s bank.
verses.en_bbe: And when she was no longer able to keep him secret, she made him a basket out of the stems of water-plants, pasting sticky earth over it to keep the water out; and placing the baby in it she put it among the plants by the edge of the Nile.

verses.en: And his sister stood afar off, to wit what would be done to him.
verses.pt: E sua irmã postou-se de longe, para saber o que lhe aconteceria.
verses.en_web: His sister stood far off, to see what would be done to him.
verses.en_bbe: And his sister took her place at a distance to see what would become of him.

verses.en: And the daughter of Pharaoh came down to wash herself at the river; and her maidens walked along by the river’s side; and when she saw the ark among the flags, she sent her maid to fetch it.
verses.pt: A filha de Faraó desceu para banhar-se no rio, e as suas criadas passeavam à beira do rio. Vendo ela a arca no meio os juncos, mandou a sua criada buscá-la.
verses.en_web: Pharaoh’s daughter came down to bathe at the river. Her maidens walked along by the riverside. She saw the basket among the reeds, and sent her servant to get it.
verses.en_bbe: Now Pharaoh's daughter came down to the Nile to take a bath, while her women were walking by the riverside; and she saw the basket among the river-plants, and sent her servant-girl to get it.

verses.en: And when she had opened it, she saw the child: and, behold, the babe wept. And she had compassion on him, and said, This is one of the Hebrews’ children.
verses.pt: E abrindo-a, viu a criança, e eis que o menino chorava; então ela teve compaixão dele, e disse: Este é um dos filhos dos hebreus.
verses.en_web: She opened it, and saw the child, and behold, the baby cried. She had compassion on him, and said, “This is one of the Hebrews’ children.”
verses.en_bbe: And opening it, she saw the child, and he was crying. And she had pity on him, and said, This is one of the Hebrews' children.

verses.en: Then said his sister to Pharaoh’s daughter, Shall I go and call to thee a nurse of the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for thee?
verses.pt: Então a irmã do menino perguntou à filha de Faraó: Queres que eu te vá chamar uma ama dentre as hebréias, para que crie este menino para ti?
verses.en_web: Then his sister said to Pharaoh’s daughter, “Should I go and call a nurse for you from the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for you?”
verses.en_bbe: Then his sister said to Pharaoh's daughter, May I go and get you one of the Hebrew women to give him the breast?

verses.en: And Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, Go. And the maid went and called the child’s mother.
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhe a filha de Faraó: Vai. Foi, pois, a moça e chamou a mãe do menino.
verses.en_web: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Go.” The young woman went and called the child’s mother.
verses.en_bbe: And Pharaoh's daughter said to her, Go. And the girl went and got the child's mother.

verses.en: And Pharaoh’s daughter said unto her, Take this child away, and nurse it for me, and I will give thee thy wages. And the woman took the child, and nursed it.
verses.pt: Disse-lhe a filha de Faraó: Leva este menino, e cria-mo; eu te darei o teu salário. E a mulher tomou o menino e o criou.
verses.en_web: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Take this child away, and nurse him for me, and I will give you your wages.” The woman took the child, and nursed it.
verses.en_bbe: And Pharaoh's daughter said to her, Take the child away and give it milk for me, and I will give you payment. And the woman took the child and gave it milk at her breast.

verses.en: And the child grew, and she brought him unto Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. And she called his name Moses: and she said, Because I drew him out of the water.
verses.pt: Quando, pois, o menino era já grande, ela o trouxe à filha de Faraó, a qual o adotou; e lhe chamou Moisés, dizendo: Porque das águas o tirei.
verses.en_web: The child grew, and she brought him to Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. She named him Moses, and said, “Because I drew him out of the water.”
verses.en_bbe: And when the child was older, she took him to Pharaoh's daughter and he became her son, and she gave him the name Moses, Because, she said, I took him out of the water.

verses.en: And it came to pass in those days, when Moses was grown, that he went out unto his brethren, and looked on their burdens: and he spied an Egyptian smiting an Hebrew, one of his brethren.
verses.pt: Ora, aconteceu naqueles dias que, sendo Moisés já homem, saiu a ter com seus irmãos e atentou para as suas cargas; e viu um egípcio que feria a um hebreu dentre, seus irmãos.
verses.en_web: In those days, when Moses had grown up, he went out to his brothers, and looked at their burdens. He saw an Egyptian striking a Hebrew, one of his brothers.
verses.en_bbe: Now when Moses had become a man, one day he went out to his people and saw how hard their work was; and he saw an Egyptian giving blows to a Hebrew, one of his people.

verses.en: And he looked this way and that way, and when he saw that there was no man, he slew the Egyptian, and hid him in the sand.
verses.pt: Olhou para um lado e para outro, e vendo que não havia ninguém ali, matou o egipcio e escondeu-o na areia.
verses.en_web: He looked this way and that way, and when he saw that there was no one, he killed the Egyptian, and hid him in the sand.
verses.en_bbe: And turning this way and that, and seeing no one, he put the Egyptian to death, covering his body with sand.

verses.en: And when he went out the second day, behold, two men of the Hebrews strove together: and he said to him that did the wrong, Wherefore smitest thou thy fellow?
verses.pt: Tornou a sair no dia seguinte, e eis que dois hebreus contendiam; e perguntou ao que fazia a injustiça: Por que feres a teu próximo?
verses.en_web: He went out the second day, and behold, two men of the Hebrews were fighting with each other. He said to him who did the wrong, “Why do you strike your fellow?”
verses.en_bbe: And he went out the day after and saw two of the Hebrews fighting: and he said to him who was in the wrong, Why are you fighting your brother?

verses.en: And he said, Who made thee a prince and a judge over us? intendest thou to kill me, as thou killedst the Egyptian? And Moses feared, and said, Surely this thing is known.
verses.pt: Respondeu ele: Quem te constituiu a ti príncipe e juiz sobre nós? Pensas tu matar-me, como mataste o egípcio? Temeu, pois, Moisés e disse: Certamente o negócio já foi descoberto.
verses.en_web: He said, “Who made you a prince and a judge over us? Do you plan to kill me, as you killed the Egyptian?” Moses was afraid, and said, “Surely this thing is known.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said, Who made you a ruler and a judge over us? are you going to put me to death as you did the Egyptian? And Moses was in fear, and said, It is clear that the thing has come to light.

verses.en: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to slay Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and dwelt in the land of Midian: and he sat down by a well.
verses.pt: E quando Faraó soube disso, procurou matar a Moisés. Este, porém, fugiu da presença de Faraó, e foi habitar na terra de Midiã; e sentou-se junto a um poço.
verses.en_web: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to kill Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and lived in the land of Midian, and he sat down by a well.
verses.en_bbe: Now when Pharaoh had news of this, he would have put Moses to death. But Moses went in flight from Pharaoh into the land of Midian: and he took his seat by a water-spring.

verses.en: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters: and they came and drew water, and filled the troughs to water their father’s flock.
verses.pt: O sacerdote de Midiã tinha sete filhas, as quais vieram tirar água, e encheram os tanques para dar de beber ao rebanho de seu pai.
verses.en_web: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters. They came and drew water, and filled the troughs to water their father’s flock.
verses.en_bbe: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters: and they came to get water for their father's flock.

verses.en: And the shepherds came and drove them away: but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.
verses.pt: Então vieram os pastores, e as expulsaram dali; Moisés, porém, levantou-se e as defendeu, e deu de beber ao rebanho delas.
verses.en_web: The shepherds came and drove them away; but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.
verses.en_bbe: And the keepers of the sheep came up and were driving them away; but Moses got up and came to their help, watering their flock for them.

verses.en: And when they came to Reuel their father, he said, How is it that ye are come so soon to day?
verses.pt: Quando elas voltaram a Reuel, seu pai, este lhes perguntou: como é que hoje voltastes tão cedo?
verses.en_web: When they came to Reuel, their father, he said, “How is it that you have returned so early today?”
verses.en_bbe: And when they came to Reuel their father, he said, How is it that you have come back so quickly today?

verses.en: And they said, An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds, and also drew water enough for us, and watered the flock.
verses.pt: Responderam elas: um egípcio nos livrou da mão dos pastores; e ainda tirou água para nós e deu de beber ao rebanho.
verses.en_web: They said, “An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds, and moreover he drew water for us, and watered the flock.”
verses.en_bbe: And they said, An Egyptian came to our help against the keepers of sheep and got water for us and gave it to the flock.

verses.en: And he said unto his daughters, And where is he? why is it that ye have left the man? call him, that he may eat bread.
verses.pt: E ele perguntou a suas filhas: Onde está ele; por que deixastes lá o homem? chamai-o para que coma pão.
verses.en_web: He said to his daughters, “Where is he? Why is it that you have left the man? Call him, that he may eat bread.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to his daughters, Where is he? why have you let the man go? make him come in and give him a meal.

verses.en: And Moses was content to dwell with the man: and he gave Moses Zipporah his daughter.
verses.pt: Então Moisés concordou em marar com aquele homem, o qual lhe deu sua filha Zípora.
verses.en_web: Moses was content to dwell with the man. He gave Moses Zipporah, his daughter.
verses.en_bbe: And Moses was happy to go on living with the man; and he gave his daughter Zipporah to Moses.

verses.en: And she bare him a son, and he called his name Gershom: for he said, I have been a stranger in a strange land.
verses.pt: E ela deu à luz um filho, a quem ele chamou Gérson, porque disse: Peregrino sou em terra estrangeira.
verses.en_web: She bore a son, and he named him Gershom, for he said, “I have lived as a foreigner in a foreign land.”
verses.en_bbe: And she gave birth to a son, to whom he gave the name Gershom: for he said, I have been living in a strange land.

verses.en: And it came to pass in process of time, that the king of Egypt died: and the children of Israel sighed by reason of the bondage, and they cried, and their cry came up unto God by reason of the bondage.
verses.pt: No decorrer de muitos dias, morreu o rei do Egito; e os filhos de Israel gemiam debaixo da servidão; pelo que clamaram, e subiu a Deus o seu clamor por causa dessa servidão.
verses.en_web: In the course of those many days, the king of Egypt died, and the children of Israel sighed because of the bondage, and they cried, and their cry came up to God because of the bondage.
verses.en_bbe: Now after a long time the king of Egypt came to his end: and the children of Israel were crying in their grief under the weight of their work, and their cry for help came to the ears of God.

verses.en: And God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.
verses.pt: Então Deus, ouvindo-lhes os gemidos, lembrou-se do seu pacto com Abraão, com Isaque e com Jacó.
verses.en_web: God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.
verses.en_bbe: And at the sound of their weeping the agreement which God had made with Abraham and Isaac and Jacob came to his mind.

verses.en: And God looked upon the children of Israel, and God had respect unto them.
verses.pt: E atentou Deus para os filhos de Israel; e Deus os conheceu.
verses.en_web: God saw the children of Israel, and God was concerned about them.
verses.en_bbe: And God's eyes were turned to the children of Israel and he gave them the knowledge of himself.
